elements.text: Probable cause statement is listed as (none)
Safety of Part 135 operations would be enhanced by required use of certificated dispatchers
Requiring joint operational control responsibility between dispatcher and PIC can minimize single-point failure likelihood
Manifest and recordkeeping requirements would help detect unsafe loading conditions
FAA safety management system final rule will help operators proactively identify and mitigate risks
Implementation of scaled safety management system can help develop effective operational control strategies
Operational flight data monitoring programs could provide objective information regarding pilot conduct
NTSB collection of operating certificate parameters will enhance database usefulness for assessing industry safety
Collection and validation of flight activity data are fundamental to determine accident rates and support evaluations
Recommendation to require certificated dispatchers for Part 135 operators (except single-pilot)
Recommendation to expand load manifest requirements to single-engine aircraft
Recommendation to develop method for generating activity data for Part 135 certificate holders
Reiterated recommendation to require flight data recording devices for Part 135 operators
